timeline.change: J150 Prado-platform launch: 4.0 1GR-FE V6 (270 hp), Trail Edition with KDSS, rear locker and Crawl Control; 2.7 four on 2WD only, 2010 only
Facelift: projector headlamps, LED tail lamps, Optitron cluster, upgraded brake lines, Trailer Sway Control
TRD Pro added: TRD-tuned Bilstein remote-reservoir shocks (Fox on later trucks), TRD front springs, front skid plate
Trail and Trail Premium renamed TRD Off-Road and TRD Off-Road Premium; same hardware
Toyota Safety Sense-P standard; Entune 3.0 with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. Autotrader says buy a late fifth gen, preferably 2020–2024
Push-button start and LED lighting standard; TRD Sport trim with X-REAS; TRD Pro gets Multi-Terrain Monitor
40th Anniversary Special Edition (4,040 units); heated wheel on upper trims
Final year; TRD Pro in exclusive Terra paint

identify.intro: Fifteen years of nearly identical bodies means the trim and hardware decide the price, and plenty of trucks wear TRD Pro badges they weren't born with.

items.head: Model codes
items.body: GRN280/285 for the 4.0 1GR-FE V6; TRN280 is the 2010-only 2.7 four on 2WD trucks.

items.head: Rear locker and KDSS
items.body: The factory e-locker and Crawl Control come on the Trail (2010–16) and TRD Off-Road (2017–24). KDSS was offered with the Trail; look for the hydraulic cylinders and lines on the sway bars.

items.head: Real TRD Pro
items.body: Introduced for 2015 with TRD-tuned Bilstein remote-reservoir shocks (Fox dampers on later trucks), TRD front springs and a TRD skid plate. Each year had an exclusive colour: Inferno Orange (2015), Quicksand (2016), Cement (2017), Cavalry Blue (2018), Voodoo Blue (2019), Army Green (2020), Lunar Rock (2021), Lime Rush (2022), Solar Octane (2023), Terra (2024).

items.head: Limited and TRD Sport
items.body: The Limited has full-time 4WD and X-REAS; the 2022-on TRD Sport also has X-REAS and 20 in wheels but only 2WD or part-time 4WD.

capability.note: C&D observed 15 mpg overall, 17 mpg at 75 mph (2022 TRD Pro)

values.intro: Prices are firm. Late low-mile TRD Pros still change hands near or above their original sticker, while early high-mile SR5s are the entry point.
values.note: Based on 22 Bring a Trailer sales from October 2025 to October 2026 (median about $38,000). The top sales were low-mile 2022–24 TRD Pros at $53,500–58,500.
